claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: SB-366791 is a TRPV1 antagonist that is unlikely to kill cells at 2.5 uM; any weak, non-selective antiproliferative effect would most plausibly reflect a physicochemical or off-target effect rather than TRPV1 blockade.
